originalTitle: SIF AUM jumps 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June; inflows surge 171% MoM
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Specialised Investment Funds (SIF) had a big increase in the amount of money they managed, growing by 29% to Rs 17,858 crore in June. This happened because a lot more money was put into these funds, with a 171% increase from the previous month. One type of fund, called Hybrid Long-Short Funds, was particularly popular. This is a good sign for the overall mutual fund industry, which also saw many investors putting in money, especially through regular investments called SIPs. This shows that regular investors like you are still very interested in putting their money into these funds.

originalTitle: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
simplifiedContent: Avenue Supermarts, the company that owns DMart stores, recently released its financial results for the quarter ending June. The company's profit increased by 11.3% to Rs 860 crore, which means it made more money than it did during the same time last year. Its revenue, or the total amount of money it made from sales, also went up by 14.9%. This increase in profit and revenue is a good sign for the company, showing that its business is performing well. The company's profitability also improved slightly, which is a positive indicator of its financial health.

originalTitle: Nearly 60% of foreign inflows into India-focused funds withdrawn since 2024 peak: Report
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Foreign investors have taken out almost 60% of the money they had invested in funds that focus on Indian stocks since the peak in 2024. This means they're moving their money out of India and into other areas, such as investments related to artificial intelligence. In 2026, $9 billion was withdrawn from India-focused funds, which is a significant amount. Meanwhile, some investors put money into gold funds and US stocks, and Europe also saw some new investment. This matters because it can affect the Indian stock market and the overall economy.

originalTitle: Nomura sees 22% upside in Ather Energy. Here's why it's the brokerage's top EV pick
simplifiedContent: Nomura, a financial company, thinks Ather Energy's stock price will go up by 22% because they believe the company has a lot of potential for growth. They are recommending that people buy Ather Energy's stock, and they've raised their expected price for the stock to ₹1,470. This is because the market for electric two-wheelers, like scooters and motorcycles, is expected to get much bigger. Ather Energy is expected to do well as more people switch to electric vehicles. This makes Ather Energy Nomura's top choice for electric vehicle companies.

originalTitle: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
simplifiedContent: A recent study by Abakkus Mutual Fund found that large cap and mid cap funds could be a good investment option right now. This is because company earnings are improving and the prices of these funds are reasonable. The market has recently gone down, which means it could be a good time for long-term investors to get in. This is because stock prices might start to match the growth in company earnings, making it a potentially good time to invest. The study suggests that now could be a good entry point for investors who are looking to invest for the long term.

originalTitle: AI chip fever returns? SK Hynix  share price surges 13% after blockbuster $26.5 billion US listing
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a company that makes computer chips, just listed its shares on the US stock market and raised a huge amount of money, $26.5 billion. The company's share price jumped up 13% on its first day, which is a very strong start. This is happening even though other similar companies have been experiencing ups and downs in the stock market lately. The main reason for this excitement is that investors are very interested in companies that make chips for artificial intelligence (AI) technology. This surge in SK Hynix's share price shows that investors think the company has a lot of potential for growth.
